articles.title: FDA report shows timeline, traceback in infant botulism outbreak traced to ByHeart formula
articles.description: In its Executive Summary, the FDA redacted the name of the company that provided ByHeart with some of the powdered milk used in the production of the implicated formula.

articles.title: Study shows link between climate and antimicrobial resistant Salmonella
articles.description: Researchers have described how climate change could have an impact on Salmonella and antimicrobial resistance. Scientists analyzed more than 236,700 Salmonella genomes from 139 countries or regions over the period 1940 to 2023. They selected annual mean temperatures and rain levels as indicators of climate change. articles.description: As of May 27 a total of 119 people infected with one of the outbreak strains of Salmonella have been reported from 36 states since the investigation began.

articles.title: Hundreds of inmates sickened in Salmonella outbreak
articles.description: The Broome County Health Department in New York has determined that the illnesses impacting more than 300 people in the Broome County Correctional Facility is Salmonella infection. articles.title: Irish illness data shows more reports of major pathogens
articles.description: Infection data from Ireland has revealed an increase in most major pathogens this past year with Salmonella at its highest level since 2008. Figures come from a report published by the Health Protection Surveillance Centre (HPSC) that includes foodborne illnesses in the last quarter and all of 2025.
